name: TBC Bank Group Plc
summary: TBC Bank Group Plc engages as the holding company of TBC Bank. The company operates through three segments: Corporate, Retail; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Corporate Center, Other and Sub-Segment Eliminations, Uzbekistan Operations, and Other Operations and Eliminations. The Corporate segment refers to a legal entity/group of affiliated entities with an annual revenue exceeding GEL 20 million or which has been granted facilities of more than GEL 7.5 million. The Retail segment deals with the non-business individual customers. The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises segment is involved with business customers not included in the CIB segment. The Other and Sub-Segment Eliminations segment comprises the treasury operations, TBC Leasing, TBC Insurance and sub-segment eliminations. The Uzbekistan Operations segment pertains to TBC Bank Uzbekistan with respective subsidiaries and Payme (Inspired LLC). The Other Operations and Eliminations segment includes non-material or non-financial subsidiaries of the group and intragroup eliminations. The company was founded on February 26, 2016, and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
